recorded.outcome:q-m-value: 'It computes each M from the variables' bounds': M = the most the row's expression can be ('the most s_i + d_i - s_j can be is H'). Here max x - y = 40 - 10 = 30.

recorded.outcome:q-order: 'relax, then gdp.hull: LP bound 17.00'. 'That LP bound is the MILP optimum, solved with binaries intact. Transform, then relax.'

recorded.outcome:q-open-bound: 'You can then pass an M yourself, apply_to(m, bigM=20), and the model solves'; the hull 'has no bigM= escape'.
